classification_definitions.PROVEN: Repository evidence directly establishes the relationship and validation supports it.
classification_definitions.DOCUMENTED: The relationship is explicitly stated, but machine validation is incomplete or absent.
classification_definitions.IMPLIED: The relationship appears intended from structure/naming/context but is not explicit enough to claim proof.
classification_definitions.MISSING: A relation required by the claimed architecture cannot be found.
classification_definitions.CONFLICTING: Two or more artifacts assert incompatible relations or boundaries.
classification_definitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The repository contains or names the artifact, but this audit lacks sufficient basis to classify the runtime/external relation.

Companion != Solver: Direct-solution and irreversible-guess cases are machine checked.
Advice != Command: External game control is rejected, but no machine field distinguishes advice from command semantics.
Hypothesis != Fact: Epistemic promotion and corrected-claim retention are rejected.
Knowledge != Spoiler Right: Known answers and prior exposure remain bounded by request and spoiler budget.
Optimal Move != Interesting Move: Objective-best and forced-ranking fields are machine checked.
Correction by Player != Model Defeat: Correction is documented as positive evidence and model revision is checked, but defeat/defensiveness has no machine representation.
Confidence != Authority: Depth remains intent/spoiler/stakes bounded and action_permit_created is false.
Request for Conversation != Request for Completion: Conversation and explicit help intents have separate ceilings.
Permission to Be Wrong != Permission to Cause Avoidable Loss: Uncertain irreversible solution remains blocked.
Remembered Correction != Permanent Player Profile: Correction and expertise remain local; profile inference is rejected.
Memory Candidate != Durable Memory: Bounded retention and expiry behavior are checked.
Memory Available != Initiative Authorized: Cross-scope/stale memory cannot authorize callback.
Silence != Invitation: Silence-only initiative is blocked.
Player Cue > System Agenda: Player focus suppresses unrelated system agenda.
Repeated Ignoring -> Less Initiative: Ignored initiative exhausts the bounded budget.
Interesting Detail != Attention Capture Right: Ignored focus and engagement objectives are blocked.
Predicted Interest != Player Intent: Prediction cannot override player selection.
Player-Selected Focus > System-Predicted Interest: Player-choice override case is canonical.

Receipt != Authority: README denies authority, while the same receipt fixture carries and the validator interprets response_authorized without a separate authority-decision/permit binding. No external game effect is authorized, but the semantic boundary is internally ambiguous.
Recall != Intent Continuity: Carry-prior-intent mutations are rejected.
Previous Help Request != Current Help Request: Stale solution request is not carried.
Session Resume != Topic Resume: Resume-thread requires a fresh compatible cue.
Remembered Spoiler Exposure != Deeper Spoiler Authority: Prior exposure cannot raise the spoiler level.
All layers are synthetic/non-executing; no live runtime or user observation was invoked, so repository artifacts do not prove runtime behavior.
